name: Opportunity
description: One round of a funding programme we pursue: the funder's facts, our fit, who owns it, how far it has got and the team lead's go-or-no-go decision.

global.schema:
type OpportunityState {
  name: String
  funderId: PHID
  programme: VaultRef
  roundLabel: String
  roundOpenedAt: DateTime
  instrument: Instrument
  amount: Amount_Money
  currency: Currency
  fundingRate: Amount_Percentage
  whereToApply: String
  rolling: Boolean!
  owner: EthereumAddress
  fit: Fit
  fitReasoning: VaultRef
  status: OpportunityStatus!
  statusReason: String
  closedAt: DateTime
  expectedOpening: Date
  decideBy: Date
  blocked: Blocked
  goNoGoDecisions: [GoNoGoDecision!]!
  steps: [Step!]!
  conditions: [Condition!]!
  attemptLimit: AttemptLimit
  applyingEntity: VaultRef
  submissions: [Submission!]!
  coordinatorId: PHID
  partners: [Partner!]!
  nextSteps: [NextStep!]!
  interactions: [Interaction!]!
  contactLinks: [ContactLink!]!
  references: [Reference!]!
  confidentialItems: [ConfidentialItem!]!
}

type VaultRef {
  id: PHID!
  title: String!
}

enum Instrument {
  GRANT
  FELLOWSHIP
  ACCELERATOR
  CONSORTIUM_CALL
  EQUITY
  IN_KIND
  PRIZE
  MIXED
}

enum Fit {
  BEST
  GOOD
  LATER
  UNLIKELY
}

enum OpportunityStatus {
  WATCHING
  TO_EVALUATE
  DECIDING
  PREPARING
  SUBMITTED
  NEXT_STAGE
  AWARDED
  REJECTED
  WITHDRAWN
  NO_GO
}

type Blocked {
  decisionId: PHID
  text: String
}

enum GoNoGo {
  GO
  NO_GO
}

type GoNoGoDecision {
  id: OID!
  decision: GoNoGo!
  decidedBy: EthereumAddress!
  reason: String!
  attemptsLeft: Int
  decidedAt: DateTime!
}

enum StepKind {
  LETTER_OF_INTENT
  CUT_OFF
  STAGE
  FULL_PROPOSAL
  INTERVIEW
  EXPECTED_RESULT
  OTHER
}

type Step {
  id: OID!
  kind: StepKind!
  label: String!
  at: DateTime!
  timeZone: String!
  targeted: Boolean!
  source: String!
  checkedAt: DateTime!
}

enum ConditionKind {
  ELIGIBILITY
  COUNTRY
  LEGAL_FORM
  READINESS
  PURPOSE
  CO_FUNDING
  CONSORTIUM
  OTHER
}

enum ConditionState {
  MET
  NOT_MET
  UNKNOWN
  WAITING_ON_DECISION
}

type Condition {
  id: OID!
  kind: ConditionKind!
  text: String!
  state: ConditionState!
  decisionIds: [PHID!]!
  factNotes: [VaultRef!]!
  source: String!
  checkedAt: DateTime!
}

type AttemptLimit {
  max: Int!
  withdrawnCounts: Boolean!
  source: String!
  checkedAt: DateTime!
}

enum SubmissionResult {
  PASSED
  AWARDED
  UNSUCCESSFUL
  WITHDRAWN
}

type SubmissionOutcome {
  result: SubmissionResult!
  amount: Amount_Money
  currency: Currency
  text: String
  receivedAt: DateTime!
}

type Submission {
  id: OID!
  stepId: OID
  submittedAt: DateTime!
  where: String
  submittedBy: EthereumAddress!
  outcome: SubmissionOutcome
}

enum PartnerStatus {
  ASKED
  INTERESTED
  COMMITTED
  SIGNED
}

type Partner {
  id: OID!
  organisationId: PHID!
  role: String
  country: String
  status: PartnerStatus!
  leadId: PHID
}

type PersonRef {
  contactId: PHID!
  personId: OID!
}

type NextStep {
  id: OID!
  text: String!
  owner: EthereumAddress
  dueDate: Date
  doneAt: DateTime
}

enum InteractionKind {
  EMAIL
  CALL
  MEETING
  EVENT
  MESSAGE
  OTHER
}

enum InteractionStatus {
  SCHEDULED
  HELD
  CANCELLED
}

type Interaction {
  id: OID!
  kind: InteractionKind!
  status: InteractionStatus!
  at: DateTime
  timeZone: String
  summary: String
  people: [PersonRef!]!
  teamMembers: [EthereumAddress!]!
  notesSource: VaultRef
}

type ContactLink {
  id: OID!
  contactId: PHID!
  personId: OID
  role: String
}

enum ReferenceKind {
  RESEARCH
  NOTE
  SOURCE
  COMPARABLE
  OPPORTUNITY
  LEAD
  DECISION
  OTHER
}

type Reference {
  id: OID!
  kind: ReferenceKind!
  documentId: PHID!
  title: String!
}

type ConfidentialItem {
  id: OID!
  subjectContactId: PHID
  text: String!
  addedBy: EthereumAddress!
  addedAt: DateTime!
}

operations.name: SET_OPPORTUNITY_DETAILS

operations.schema:
input SetOpportunityDetailsInput {
  name: String
  funderId: PHID
  programme: SetOpportunityDetailsProgrammeInput
  roundLabel: String
  roundOpenedAt: DateTime
  instrument: Instrument
  amount: Amount_Money
  currency: Currency
  fundingRate: Amount_Percentage
  whereToApply: String
  rolling: Boolean
}

input SetOpportunityDetailsProgrammeInput {
  id: PHID!
  title: String!
}
operations.template: Set the opportunity's name, funder, programme, round, instrument, amount with its currency, funding rate, where to apply and whether it is rolling; a field left out is unchanged
